articles.title: Have we just entered a new era for cyber security? | BBC Newscast
articles.titleZh: 我们是否刚刚进入网络安全的新时代？ | BBC新闻广播
articles.summary:
Millions of websites around the world are dealing with the discovery of a potential cyber-security threat using artificial intelligence.

Vulnerabilities were found in the PHP programming language, which is used on roughly 70% of the internet, by researchers using AI. These flaws had gone undetected for over a decade, with the boss of the UK's National Cyber Security Centre saying the scale of the issue has been “unprecedented”.

Technology and AI editor Zoe Kleinman joins Adam to explain what has happened, and how the weakness was identified.

Plus, President Trump’s special envoy Steve Witkoff has had talks with Volodymyr Zelensky and Vladimir Putin, whom he called a “humanitarian”. Russia editor Steve Rosenberg tells us what’s significant about the latest developments and whether the prospect of peace is any closer.

Subscribe to our channel here: https://bbc.in/bbcnews

For the latest news download the BBC News app or visit BBC.com/news

articles.readingTextZh:
全球数以百万计的网站正在处理使用人工智能发现的潜在网络安全威胁。

研究人员使用人工智能，在大约70 ％的互联网上使用的PHP编程语言中发现了漏洞。

十多年来，这些漏洞一直没有被发现，英国国家网络安全中心的老板表示，这个问题的规模是“前所未有的”。

技术和人工智能编辑Zoe Kleinman与Adam一起解释发生了什么，以及如何识别弱点。

此外，特朗普总统的特使史蒂夫·维特科夫（ Steve Witkoff ）与弗拉基米尔·泽伦斯基（ Volodymyr Zelensky ）和弗拉基米尔·普京（ Vladimir Putin ）进行了会

俄罗斯编辑史蒂夫·罗森伯格（ Steve Rosenberg ）向我们介绍了最新事态发展的重要性，以及和平的前景是否更加接近。

articles.title: Donald Trump blames Iran for high oil prices | BBC News
articles.titleZh: 唐纳德·特朗普指责伊朗油价高企| BBC新闻
articles.summary:
US President Donald Trump has said that something will happen "fairly soon" in his country's conflict with Iran. It comes amid reports that the US and Israeli militaries have developed plans for a major new wave of strikes.
 
Meanwhile, oil prices have risen to their highest for five months. Trump puts the blame on Iran, saying the country is doing all it can to drive prices up before the US midterm elections.
 
Reports from Saudi Arabia say that the state oil company Aramco has evacuated its headquarters in the eastern city of Dhahran, as Houthi attacks on the country continue.
 
And inside Yemen, the United Nations says more than two million children are malnourished.

Subscribe to our channel here: https://bbc.in/bbcnews

For the latest news download the BBC News app or visit BBC.com/news

#Iran #US #MiddleEast #BBCNews

美国总统唐纳德·特朗普（ Donald Trump ）曾表示，在他的国家与伊朗的冲突中， “很快”就会发生一些事情。

articles.title: Is AI helping or harming cyber-security amid the PHP hacking attempts | Global News Podcast
articles.titleZh: 在PHP黑客攻击企图中，人工智能是在帮助还是在损害网络安全|全球新闻播客
articles.summary:
Cyber-security experts have used AI tools to uncover a major flaw in the programming language behind many websites, known as PHP. That has led governments, businesses and other organisations around the world scrambling to fix the problem, with many sites going dark. Analysts say hackers have made millions of attempts - using AI - to try to exploit the problem. 

We hear from cyber researcher Ryan Austin, who discovered the PHP flaw, and ask our tech correspondent about the power and danger of AI. 

Also in the Global News Podcast:  

07:23 We hear from Arab-Israeli voters - also known as Palestinian citizens of Israel - as Israel prepares for its first general election since the Hamas attacks of 7th October 2023. Polls show that neither Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu nor his main rivals have an easy path to forming a coalition government. That means small Arab-majority parties could hold the balance of power, depending on whom they decide to support. 

The Global News Podcast brings you the best of the BBC’s news coverage and analysis from around the world. 

New audio episodes of the Global News Podcast are published twice a day. You can listen here: https://link.mgln.ai/GNP-YT

And you can find more of our YouTube episodes here: https://bbc.in/GlobalNewsPodcast

If you would like to get in touch, you can email us at globalpodcast@bbc.co.uk. 

Subscribe to our channel here: https://bbc.in/bbcnews

For the latest news download the BBC News app or visit BBC.com/news

#BBCNews

articles.title: Billionaire pardoned after hiring Trump's ex-lawyer for $50M: NYT
articles.titleZh: 亿万富翁以5000万美元聘请特朗普的前律师后获得赦免：纽约时报
articles.summary:
Trump ally Alina Habba accepted a job that would pay her $50 million even as she served as a top adviser in Trump’s Justice Department — shortly before the billionaire Venezuelan banker who hired her got a pardon he had been seeking. She denied any role in the pardon.

The New York Times’ Tyler Pager reported that Alina Habba secured the $50 million employment deal with a company that had only recently been set up and doesn’t have a public profile. She also reportedly finalized the deal even as she was still serving as US attorney in New Jersey, and she began the job when she was serving as a special government employee advising then-Attorney General Pam Bondi. Two weeks after she started her job, the Venezuelan banker who hired her — Julio Herrera Velutini — received his pardon, the Times reported.

articles.readingText:
Trump ally Alina Habba accepted a job that would pay her $50 million even as she served as a top adviser in Trump’s Justice Department — shortly before the billionaire Venezuelan banker who hired her got a pardon he had been seeking.

She denied any role in the pardon.

The New York Times’ Tyler Pager reported that Alina Habba secured the $50 million employment deal with a company that had only recently been set up and doesn’t have a public profile.

She also reportedly finalized the deal even as she was still serving as US attorney in New Jersey, and she began the job when she was serving as a special government employee advising then-Attorney General Pam Bondi.

Two weeks after she started her job, the Venezuelan banker who hired her — Julio Herrera Velutini — received his pardon, the Times reported.
articles.readingTextZh:
特朗普的盟友阿丽娜·哈巴（ Alina Habba ）接受了一份薪水为5000万美元的工作，尽管她曾在特朗普司法部担任高级顾问—就在这位雇用她的亿万富翁委内瑞拉银行家获得他一直在寻求的赦免之前不久。

她否认在赦免中扮演任何角色。

《纽约时报》的泰勒·佩格（ Tyler Pager ）报道说，阿丽娜·哈巴（ Alina Habba ）与一家最近才成立但没有公开资料的公司达成了5000万美元的就业协议$。

据报道，即使她仍在新泽西州担任美国检察官，她也完成了这笔交易，她在担任特别政府雇员时开始了这项工作，为当时的司法部长Pam Bondi提供咨询。

据《泰晤士报》报道，在她开始工作两周后，雇用她的委内瑞拉银行家胡里奥·埃雷拉·韦卢蒂尼（ Julio Herrera Velutini ）获得了赦免。
